title: ashOpenLineageProducer (run facet)
description: Custom run facet emitted by ash_open_lineage naming the Ash job that produced the event: namespace, resource, action and table names, plus the host's correlation id and depth. Structural names only - never actor identities, tenant ids, or filter/argument values.

_producer.description: URI identifying the producer of this metadata.

producer_name.description: Dot-joined structural names of the producing job, e.g. "calendar.calendar_event.create". Deliberately contains no actor, tenant, or data values.

correlationId.description: The host's correlation id for the operation (an opaque id from the configured correlation provider), matching the audit trail's correlation id. Present on notifier-emitted events.

depth.description: The correlation provider's nesting depth for the operation; above zero means nested under an outer operation.
